I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land in total extent of about 0.3376 Hectare,depicted as Lot A in the Advance Tracing No. Ya/VDN/2016/314dated 28.02.2017 prepared by the Senior superintendent of SurveysJaffna District, situated in the Village called Puloly Centre in theGrama Niladari Division No. J/409 in the Vadamaradchi North in theDivisional Secretary’s Division in Jaffna District in Northern Provinceand bounded as follows:

North: Name of land not known, claimed by Sri Lanka TransportBoard, Name of land not known, claimed by Rukkumani wife ofSankarappillai and Name of land not known, claimed byThankavelautham Anparasan; East: Name of land not known, claimed

by Rukkumani wife of Sankarappillai, Name of land not known,claimed by Thankavelautham Anparasan and Road (R.D.A.); South:Road (R.D.A.) and Name of land not known and claimed by SriLanka Transport Board; West: Name of land not known and claimedby Sri Lanka Transport Board.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
